goal: Generate a vertical event poster with the Chinese slogan as the absolute focus, closely resembling Japanese promotional pages from the late Showa to early Heisei periods but in Chinese, with minimal geometric decoration and prioritizing readability.

headline.language: Chinese main label, with English and numbers as supplementary.
headline.size: Occupies about 58% height of the frame
headline.alignment: Horizontally centered, slightly above, bottom of the text aligned with an invisible golden ratio horizontal line.
headline.treatment: Layered half-step red misalignment outside the bold black outline, with localized sanded texture dots and 20% transparent noise, white core with black edges enhancing legibility at a distance

subheadline.size: The width is one-fourth of the height of the main label font.
subheadline.position: Centered lowercase sans-serif at 6% from the bottom edge of the main label, all in uppercase.

items: 4.28 - 5.4 closed section of the urban riverside greenway for morning runs and family runs
Co-organizers: Chengbin City Sports Bureau · Heart Bridge Public Welfare Foundation
small_text.position: Bottom left and right corners, left for date line, right for joint office line, not exceeding 8mm within safe cut

design.decoration: Four small circles, two short thick arrows, a diagonal 30° thin line segmenting the block surface, not crossing the main strokes
design.typography_family: Chinese: Modern ultra-bold black; English: narrow geometric sans-serif; only within three weights of two families

aspect_ratio: 3:4 print, bleed of 3mm outside, no key small text cut off

must_keep: The main slogan can be discerned at a glance from across the street.
No more than three main color blocks (red, beige, black line).
decorations ≤5 and transparency lower than 40% do not obscure text
The entire text has no typos, and the numbers and years are self-consistent
avoid: Main text smaller than 40% of the height of the image
Add a fourth large area color for show-off
Dot pattern dense to the point of looking gray and dirty
The English subtitle is larger than the Chinese main title
